meaning: GET /api/v1/update/history reads Hyalos directly, never appliance/harmonia-press. Today the reader returns at most the ten latest distinct Harmonia profile runs (src/lib/hyalos_store.rs:1164-1175), not an unbounded history.

runs.meaning: Projected run rows, empty on read failure.

finished_at.meaning: Finish time, falling back to deed time.

outcome.meaning: Normalized ok or failed outcome; null if unrecognized.

failures.meaning: Failure rows, or empty if absent.

level.meaning: Body log level, or null when unavailable.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists the history read's fixed failure signal; successful history JSON has no such field before the common door stamp.
